name: Karolina Kondrat
headline: Director of Partnerships | ISV & Technology Ecosystems | Driving Partner-Led Growth
about:
Technology partnerships and ecosystem leader with 8+ years operating across commerce, MarTech, and SaaS ecosystems, and 4+ years building and scaling formal partnership programs end-to-end.

My background spans ecommerce agencies and platform-adjacent environments, where I’ve worked closely with ISVs, product teams, and go-to-market leaders to turn integrations and partnerships into meaningful, measurable growth channels.

I specialize in defining partner strategy, launching co-sell and enablement motions, and aligning Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and CX to ensure partnerships deliver real customer value.

I’m deeply energized by fast-moving environments, complex ecosystem challenges, and the opportunity to shape how technology partners work together to create better outcomes for businesses and their customers.
… more

experiences.description:
I lead Domaine’s technology and ecosystem partnerships, owning the strategy, growth, and performance of a global ecosystem of commerce, MarTech, and SaaS partners.

I’m responsible for defining partner selection criteria, launching and scaling Domaine’s partner program, and driving partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue through co-sell motions, enablement, and cross-functional alignment.

My role sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Delivery, ensuring partnerships and integrations are positioned around real customer use cases and long-term value.

Domaine is the world’s largest independent Shopify design and development partner, formed through the union of Tomorrow and Half Helix.

experiences.position: Director of Partnerships (Formerly Tomorrow; Now Domaine)
Associate Director of Marketing & Partnerships (Formerly Tomorrow; Now Domaine)

experiences.description:
Led strategy and team leadership across Accounts, Marketing, and Business Development, partnering closely with executive leadership to drive client success while supporting the company’s long-term growth and strategic direction.

Served as a senior advisor to clients, working alongside internal delivery teams to deeply understand business objectives, identify platform and technology challenges, and consult on the right solutions across complex, multi-workstream engagements.

Acted as a key liaison between clients, internal teams, and external technology partners, supporting platform decision-making, integration planning, and scalable growth strategies.

Led initiatives to strengthen the agency’s market positioning through technology-led partnerships, thought leadership, and continuous refinement of service narratives to maintain a strong and credible industry presence.

Supported NYIT's global marketing, branding, and recruitment strategies at the Vancouver Campus through project coordination across varying teams at the global campuses and leading:

• Social media marketing strategy and redesign
• Digital campaign creation, management, and optimization
• Email marketing strategy creation and management
• Brand and community voice and communication
• Building and maintaining relationships with local government, community, and education leaders

Within the organization's Health & Beauty department as a Canadian distributor for international brands, I supported a national team of Account Executives with regards to all marketing and sales initiatives. This included collaborating with marketing and sales team in planning and executing brand initiatives, leading in event planning for national training and brand events, and overseeing the team's sales budget and targets to ensure goals are being met or exceeded.

Represented various brands through retail executions to drive meaningful interactions with audiences, creating a better way to drive desire, create demand, and deliver growth for clients.

Previous campaigns included: Mars, Nespresso, Loreal, Redbox.

Assisted as a primary media contact to book/arrange media interviews for the firm's clients. This involved writing, preparing, and disseminating press and promotional material to send out to media and clients, through media releases, invites and creative materials.
